name: Musa Cafe
tagline: Online ordering and POS software that connects customer orders, counter sales, staff workflows, and administration in one system.
description: Musa Cafe is live restaurant software: a customer website, staff POS, and admin dashboard on a shared Go API. Orders, printing, history, analytics, and offline-capable POS flows keep the counter moving in real shop conditions.

coverImage.alt: Musa Cafe restaurant POS and online ordering platform

screenshots.alt: Musa Cafe POS and ordering system screenshot

problem: Independent restaurants often run a website for online orders, a separate POS at the counter, and no unified admin view. Orders get lost between systems, and owners lack a single source of truth for sales and history.
approach: One Go backend serving three purpose-built frontends: a customer ordering site, a staff POS optimized for speed and offline resilience, and an admin dashboard for products, orders, and analytics.
solution: A full restaurant stack where website orders and counter sales land in one system. Staff get POS workflows for orders, printing, and history; admins get operational controls and analytics.
outcome: Live shop software in active restaurant use, handling real customer orders from website to kitchen.
features: Customer-facing website for browsing and online ordering
Staff POS for counter orders, tickets, and fast checkout
Admin dashboard for catalog, orders, and business oversight
Offline-capable POS flows for unreliable networks
Order printing and kitchen-facing operational handoff
Order history and sales analytics for owners
architecture: Three Next.js frontends (website, POS, admin) on a shared Go (Gin) REST API and PostgreSQL, so online and in-store channels stay synchronized.
